title: Who owns the transcript after the meeting?
dek: A transcript is not just a note. It is a file with an owner, a home, a sharing rule and sometimes an administrator who can still see it after you have forgotten the call. I traced the three big platform paths, then the very different local one.
description: Who can see a meeting transcript after the call? Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and Zoom store and share it differently. The practical question to ask before you press Record.
